The '''mind spider''' was a behemothan beast of extraordinary proportions. They were known to support themselves, standing upright on their abdomens, by anchoring eight crystalline appendages into earthen canyon walls around them.

==Behind the scenes==
The mind spider has yet to be properly categorized, some feeling it to be a [[Spider/Legends|spider]], others a slug-like species.

One specimen in its larval stage was used as the base of [[Krake Data Vault]] on [[Krake's Planet]].

Another gargantuan [[Spider/Legends|spider]] is the [[Beast in the Mouth of the Mountain]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].
